Two Birds Innovation

Product overview · Status as of 9 October 2026

Operations first. The products come out of the shop floor.

I set out to build a product and found the real problem was the factory behind it: how one person builds, tests, ships and adapts software without a development team.

So I built the shop floor first: the guardrails that keep it safe, the governance that keeps it honest, and the process flexibility that lets a business person run real software projects at near-zero cost. AI agents do the building. I set the direction, make the decisions and check the work.

Five tools and learning sites are publicly viewable. Every product below carries an Alpha tag. Proposed offers and extensions are identified within their blocks.

Product overview · 04 / 10
Alpha

A guided toolkit for starting your own fractional, consulting or side-gig business[working name: none yet]

A Wix-style guided builder for new independent businesses in Southwestern Ontario. Say what you want to build: a consultancy, store, product or fractional role, plus your reach and goals.

Status: concept, not yet built

  • Direction: a business plan and a practical roadmap.
  • Structure: sole proprietorship, corporation or partnership, with plain-language risks and rewards.
  • Registration: registering the business and sales tax (HST) basics, pointing to official sources.
  • Checkpoints: insurance, legal considerations and certifications to consider, with official sources and professional advice where needed.
  • Practical setup: calendar and booking, business email, a simple website, and an offer and price page.
  • AI help at each step: using the person’s own AI models.

For: New fractional and side-gig workers, students starting a business, and municipal and community economic-development teams offering a tool to local entrepreneurs.

Potential: promising to test locally; the guided product remains a concept.

* Open backlog items: about 48 (rough count, Consulting/site).
